t: DON’T BUY THE LIE - This Redeemed Life
s: January 22, 2018 - Jesus called our enemy the “Father of Lies.” And even though Satan can’t do one single thing about our salvation or rightful position we have as a Child of God, he will certainly try to deceive us and aims to “steal, kill and destroy” the abundant life that is ours in Christ. His mode of operation from the very beginning has been deception, and he is still at work today— aiming to deceive us about our identity, destinies, power and ability. When we buy into these lies, it affects everything about us—our self-worth, our relationships, our callings and our experience of the Christian life.

t: Don't Buy the Lie: Discerning Truth in a World of Deception by Mark Matlock, Paperback | Barnes & Noble®
s: Using Barna research and biblical truths, Mark Matlock separates the truths from the lies we are told and helps teens like you avoid the traps that can lead to deception. We all know demogorgons aren’t real, and that evil dolls can’t come to life … but are there elements of the paranormal that are really around us on earth? And if so, what does that mean?
